howToPlay: Use your fast movement speed and quick reload to pressure enemies. Deploy your Super to initiate team pushes or retreat. Choose between Phase Shifter for dashes or Sneaky Sneakers to heal damage.
gears: SPEED gear takes advantage of Max's mobility. DAMAGE gear increases offensive pressure, and GADGET COOLDOWN gear allows for more frequent use of survival tools.
trait: Max suits players who enjoy aggressive support roles that focus on mobility and team utility.
